extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded adjudication of mechanism claims from local XML/PDF/OA figure captions and result/method sections; no unsupported pathway or protein-synthesis mechanism is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Q4-15a-1 rapidly interacts with the MDR ETEC surface and penetrates the cell membrane within 30 min in the reported FITC/FM4-64 confocal localization assay.
direct_assay_types: FITC-labeled peptide localization by confocal microscopy with FM4-64 membrane dye
mechanism_claims.limitations: Localization supports membrane interaction/entry timing, not a complete molecular pore model.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Q4-15a-1 compromises MDR ETEC membrane integrity in source-reported PI/Hoechst confocal imaging and TEM observations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural damage is directly observed; exact quantitative image-derived kinetics are not over-digitized from figures.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Q4-15a-1 has source-supported antibiofilm activity against MDR ETEC, with MBEC/MBECb around 16 µg/mL and viable biofilm cell percentages reported in Tables 3 and 4.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Antibiofilm phenotype is not assigned to a separate quorum-sensing pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Q4-15a-1 reduces MDR ETEC adherence to IPEC-1 cells in the reported infection model, including source-prose support for reduced adherence at 4 µg/mL and complete inhibition above 32 µg/mL.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Q4-15a-1 in MDR ETEC/IPEC-1 adherence model
mechanism_claims.limitations: Adherence reduction is a cell-model activity outcome, not proof of a distinct molecular target.
